summary: Farmmi, Inc. filed a Form 6-K on August 12, 2026. The filing reports two items: (1) receipt of a Nasdaq deficiency notice for minimum bid price below $1.00 for 30 consecutive business days, triggering a 180-day compliance period ending February 8, 2027, with potential for a reverse stock split and a secondary grace period; and (2) entry into an Exchange Agreement with Atlas Sciences, LLC partitioning a $200,000 promissory note, exchanged for 1,581,027 Class A ordinary shares under Section 3(a)(9). Neither event constitutes a special-situation transaction; the exchange is routine debt conversion and the Nasdaq notice is regulatory.
